items.text: Leave the hotel. Konbini breakfast on the way.
Walk to Kyoto-Kawaramachi (~15 min), Hankyu Kyoto Line to Katsura, change to the Arashiyama Line to Arashiyama (¥240). Check the Sunday timetable.
~7 min from the station, on the way. Just after sunrise (~6:35). Free.
Togetsukyō → north to the lower end of the bamboo path (use the Bamboo path pin).
Before the crowds. Open 24 h, free.
Garden via the north gate on the bamboo path (¥500). Early opening from 7:30 on 14–30 Nov. Halls (+¥300, from 8:30) and Cloud Dragon don't fit before Ōkōchi.
Free gap before Ōkōchi opens: short climb to the gorge view.
Or a quiet walk in Kameyama park (the deck is inside it).
Probably not: opens 9:00 (after the gap), ~200 steps, across the river.
Probably not: opens 9:00, clashes with Ōkōchi; across the river.
Up the top end of the bamboo path to Ōkōchi Sansō.
Villa garden (¥1,000; keep the ticket for the matcha and sweet). This is the snack before the tour.
North through the Ogura-yama lanes, past Jōjakkō-ji and Nison-in, to Giō-ji.
Moss garden (¥300). 📿 stamp.
~5 min north of Giō-ji. Free.
8,000 stone memorials and a small quiet bamboo path (¥500, 9:00–16:30). Then ~25–30 min walk to Saga-Arashiyama Stn for the ~12:15 train. No slack.
Skipping K35 and K36 gives ~40 min spare: walk straight from Giō-ji to the station (~20 min), earlier train, and a quick bite near Nijō before 12:50.
Walk to JR Saga-Arashiyama Stn.
items.dur: ~20 min from Giō-ji, ~25–30 min from Adashino

items.text: JR Sagano Line Saga-Arashiyama → Nijō, then Tōzai Line one stop to Nijōjō-mae (exit by the castle), 2 min to Higashi-Ōte-mon. Or walk from JR Nijō along the south wall (~15 min).
No lunch before the tour: grab something small near Nijō Stn if needed.
Samurai Walking Tour 13:00–16:00, admission included. Meet 12:50 outside Higashi-Ōte-mon Gate (east main gate), TripTomo sign. Don't buy tickets or enter first. Gojōin card, not a 📿 stamp.
Late lunch near the castle or on the way back: soba or yudōfu, chosen on the spot.
Tōzai Line Nijōjō-mae → Sanjō Keihan, Keihan → Kiyomizu-Gojō; or taxi.
Free time after ~17:00. Dinner chosen on the spot, or K16 / K15 if booked.
